title: Tirapazamine-loaded CalliSpheres microspheres for liver cancer treatment
author: Zhang, Hong, et al.

steps.title: Prepare TPZ stock solutions
steps.instruction: Weigh tirapazamine (TPZ, SR4233, ApexBio) and dissolve it separately in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO), purified water, isotonic citrate buffer, and 7 % HCl to make the following stock solutions: TPZ‑DMSO 20 mg ml⁻¹, TPZ‑water 1.5 mg ml⁻¹, TPZ‑citrate buffer 1.5 mg ml⁻¹, TPZ‑7 % HCl (5 mg ml⁻¹), and TPZ‑7 % HCl (10 mg ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Weigh microspheres
steps.instruction: Weigh CalliSpheres microspheres (size 100–300 µm, Jiangsu Hengrui Medicine) and place exactly 1 g into each sterile vial.

steps.title: Add TPZ solution for 35 mg/g loading
steps.instruction: To separate vials containing 1 g microspheres, add the following volumes to achieve a theoretical loading of 35 mg TPZ g⁻¹ microspheres: 1.75 ml TPZ‑DMSO (20 mg ml⁻¹), 23.3 ml TPZ‑water (1.5 mg ml⁻¹), 23.3 ml TPZ‑citrate buffer (1.5 mg ml⁻¹), 7 ml TPZ‑7 % HCl (5 mg ml⁻¹), and 3.5 ml TPZ‑7 % HCl (10 mg ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Add TPZ solution for 70 mg/g loading
steps.instruction: To separate vials containing 1 g microspheres, add the following volumes to achieve a theoretical loading of 70 mg TPZ g⁻¹ microspheres: 3.5 ml TPZ‑DMSO (20 mg ml⁻¹), 46.6 ml TPZ‑water (1.5 mg ml⁻¹), 46.6 ml TPZ‑citrate buffer (1.5 mg ml⁻¹), 14 ml TPZ‑7 % HCl (5 mg ml⁻¹), and 7 ml TPZ‑7 % HCl (10 mg ml⁻¹).

steps.title: Incubate and sample supernatant
steps.instruction: Gently shake each vial, start a timer, and at 15 min, 30 min, and 60 min withdraw an equal volume of supernatant from each mixture for analysis.

steps.title: Determine residual TPZ by HPLC
steps.instruction: Analyze each supernatant sample on a WATERS ACQUITY UPLC HSS T3 column (2.1 × 100 mm, 1.8 µm) using the following HPLC conditions: injection volume 20 µl, flow rate 0.45 ml min⁻¹, column temperature 35 °C, mobile phase A = acetonitrile + 0.1 % H₃PO₄, mobile phase B = water + 0.1 % H₃PO₄. Record the TPZ peak area to calculate residual TPZ concentration.

steps.title: Calculate loading capacity
steps.instruction: For each time point, compute the drug loading capacity (mg TPZ per g microspheres) from the difference between the theoretical TPZ amount added and the residual TPZ measured. Perform all experiments in triplicate.

steps.title: Load CSMs with optimal TPZ solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 70 mg TPZ in 7 ml of 7 % HCl (10 mg ml⁻¹). Add this solution to 1 g CalliSpheres microspheres, gently shake, and incubate for 60 min. The resulting loading is 23.2 mg TPZ g⁻¹ CSMs, which will be used for subsequent drug‑release experiments.

steps.title: Prepare rabbits for transcatheter injection
steps.instruction: Anesthetize each rabbit (method as previously described), sterilize the femoral region, make a skin‑and‑muscle incision, isolate the femoral artery, and puncture it using a modified Seldinger technique.

steps.title: Catheterize hepatic artery under DSA
steps.instruction: Under digital subtraction angiography (Siemens Angiostar Plus, Germany), insert a 4‑F Cobra visceral catheter (Terumo, Japan) to locate the hepatic artery. Advance a 2.7‑F Progreat coaxial microcatheter (Terumo) to select the tumor‑feeding artery.

steps.title: Inject TPZ or CSMTPZs according to group
steps.instruction:
Perform intra‑arterial injections as follows:
• TPZ group: inject TPZ dissolved in 7 % HCl at 10 mg ml⁻¹ (10 mg per 1 ml) to deliver a dose of 1 mg kg⁻¹ body weight.
• CSMTPZs group: inject the pre‑loaded CSMTPZs (23.2 mg TPZ g⁻¹) to deliver an equivalent TPZ dose of 1 mg kg⁻¹.
• TPZ + TAE group: inject TPZ as above (1 mg kg⁻¹) then inject blank CalliSpheres microspheres (Jiangsu Hengrui) until arterial inflow occlusion is observed (embolization endpoint).
• CSMTPZ + TAE group: inject CSMTPZs delivering 1 mg kg⁻¹ TPZ, optionally followed by blank microspheres for embolization.

steps.title: Finish arterial access
steps.instruction: Remove all sheaths and catheters, ligate the femoral artery, and close the incision with appropriate sutures.

steps.title: Prepare plasma and tumor samples for HPLC‑MS/MS
steps.instruction: Collect blood plasma and homogenized tumor tissue from each rabbit at the planned time points. Store samples appropriately for analysis.

steps.title: Run HPLC‑MS/MS analysis
steps.instruction: Separate analytes on a WATERS ACQUITY UPLC HSS T3 column (2.1 × 100 mm, 1.8 µm) using: injection volume 5 µl, flow rate 0.6 ml min⁻¹, column temperature 40 °C, mobile phase A = 0.1 % formic acid in aqueous ammonium acetate (10 mM), mobile phase B = 0.1 % formic acid in ammonium acetate (10 mM) methanol. Detect TPZ, SR4317, and SR4330 on an AB Q‑Trap 6500 (Applied Biosystems) with the following MS settings: positive electrospray ionization (ESI+), multiple‑reaction monitoring (MRM), spray voltage 3000 V, source temperature 650 °C, GAS1 65 psi, GAS2 75 psi. Acquire data with Analyst 1.6.3 software.
